title: IPv4 ACL Troubleshooting with Traffic Matrix
summary: Troubleshoot and remediate IPv4 standard and extended Access Control Lists using a structured traffic matrix. Identify and correct common ACL design and implementation faults including shadowed rules, directional misplacement (inbound vs. outbound), and inverted wildcard masks on Cisco IOS routers.
learning_objectives: Analyze enterprise traffic matrices to extract and validate granular Layer 3 and Layer 4 security requirements
Identify shadowed and unexecutable ACL rules caused by broad deny statements preceding specific permit statements
Distinguish between inbound and outbound interface ACL application directions to prevent unintended packet drops and CPU overhead
Detect and correct wildcard mask calculation errors, including inverted subnet masks on standard access lists
Use Cisco IOS verification commands (show access-lists, show ip interface) and traffic probe counters to confirm deterministic traffic filtering

source.origin: Independently authored network security troubleshooting laboratory guide based on Cisco IOS IPv4 access control list architecture and security filtering best practices
